component.name: whipsaw
component.summary: A CD-DA ripper prioritising accuracy over speed (a fork of whipper)

description.p: whipsaw is a command-line CD-DA ripper that focuses on making accurate rips over fast ones. It is an unofficial fork of whipper, with a fallback-chain cover art/metadata pipeline and ffmpeg-based multi-format encoding; see NOTICE in the source repository for details.
